# CANDIDATE: VIX_LOW_GAP_FADE_RSI_REVERSAL

**Filed:** 2026-09-10
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

In low-VIX sessions (VIX < 18), opening gaps tend to fade, and extreme short-term RSI readings (2-period RSI on 5-min bars) provide a counter-trend entry opportunity. The strategy fades gaps that exceed 0.2% in either direction when the first 5-min bar closes opposite the gap direction and RSI is extreme (>80 for gap up, <20 for gap down), with additional confirmation from EMA ribbon (9-EMA below 21-EMA for gap up fades, above for gap down fades).

## Mechanism

Entry: If SPY opens with a gap >0.2% (up or down) and the first 5-min bar closes opposite the gap direction (gap up → red close, gap down → green close), and the 2-period RSI (5-min) is >80 for a gap up or <20 for a gap down, enter a fade position at the bar’s close (short for gap up, long for gap down), provided the 9-EMA is below the 21-EMA for gap up fades (bearish ribbon) or above for gap down fades (bullish ribbon).
Exit: Stop at the high/low of the gap bar (opposite side of entry); target 1R; if price moves 0.5R in favor, tighten stop to break-even; exit at end of day (no runner).
Regime: Only when VIX < 18 and time between 09:30‑10:30 ET; avoid high‑impact news days approximated by VIX >22 or opening range >0.5% of price.
